Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original scene illustration for an adult A1 German study website.
Primary request: A sick adult man seated upright in bed beneath a duvet, pressing one hand gently to his forehead, looking unwell and tired. A clearly visible thermometer rests on the bedside table; the scene communicates that he needs a doctor.
Scene/backdrop: A simple bedroom against a warm cream background, bed and one bedside table only.
Style/medium: Modern friendly editorial flat raster illustration with clean ink navy outlines, restrained indigo, teal and coral accents, rounded shapes and simple flat color fills. Professional and adult, not childish.
Composition/framing: Single landscape composition approximately 3:2. Show the man's face, hand on forehead, duvet, bed and thermometer clearly. Bold simple silhouettes readable at 320px width, with ample outer margins and uncluttered background.
Lighting/mood: Gentle calm visual tone; sympathetic illness expression.
Color palette: Warm cream background, navy ink linework, indigo duvet, teal and small coral details.
Constraints: One adult man only. Anatomically coherent hands. No writing, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, copyrighted characters, photographic elements or reference images. Thermometer has no numeric markings. Do not create a collage or multiple panels.

Use case: illustration-story

Primary request: An adult man looking inside an open refrigerator that is obviously completely empty. His slight puzzled, disappointed expression and the bare interior communicate that he needs to go grocery shopping.
Scene/backdrop: Simple kitchen against a warm cream background. An upright refrigerator with door swung open and visible empty interior shelves, empty drawers and empty door compartments.
Subject: One adult man wearing a plain teal shirt and dark indigo trousers, leaning slightly forward, one hand holding the open refrigerator door, gazing into its empty interior.
Style/medium: Modern friendly editorial flat raster illustration with clean ink navy outlines, restrained indigo, teal and coral accents, rounded shapes, simple flat color fills. Professional adult style, not childish.
Composition/framing: Single landscape composition approximately 3:2. Three-quarter view makes the man's face and the entirely empty fridge simultaneously clear. Bold simple silhouettes readable at 320px width, generous outer margins, uncluttered background. Keep the entire refrigerator inside the frame.
Lighting/mood: Soft calm kitchen light, mild everyday frustration.
Color palette: Warm cream background, navy ink linework, teal shirt, indigo trousers, subtle coral accent.
Constraints: Refrigerator is completely empty: no food, bottles, packages or containers anywhere inside. One adult man only, natural coherent anatomy. No writing, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, copyrighted characters, photographic elements or reference images. Do not create a collage or multiple panels.
